title: About BetterTampakan
intro: BetterTampakan is a volunteer-run community portal for the Municipality of Tampakan, South Cotabato. It gathers public information about the municipality in one place that is easy to read on a phone: elected officials, barangays, population figures and, as they are added, services and public finances.

independent.title: Independent, not official
independent.body: This portal is not run by the Municipal Government of Tampakan. For official announcements, follow the <fb>LGU's Facebook page</fb>.

sources.title: Where the information comes from
sources.body: We use published public sources: the Philippine Statistics Authority, the Department of Trade and Industry, published election results and local news reports. Every figure is recorded with its source in our <src>sources file</src>. Some entries are still being confirmed with the LGU.

corrections.title: Corrections are welcome
corrections.body: If something is wrong or out of date, tell us through "Suggest a correction" and we will fix it.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Built on the open-source <lb>BetterLB template</lb> and part of the <bg>BetterGov.ph</bg> community of volunteer-built local portals. Free to reuse under <cc>CC0</cc>.
